answer: For operated facilities, TotalEnergies targets a 70% reduction in methane emissions from 2020 to 2026 and an 80% reduction from 2020 to 2030 (or sooner), excluding biogenic methane. For operated upstream oil and gas facilities it targets methane intensity below 0.1%. Reported 2025 performance was 22.5 kt CH4 gross methane emissions and 0.07% methane intensity, versus a 64 kt CH4 baseline in 2020.

normalized_value.intensity_boundary: operated upstream oil and gas facilities
